commands.alternateToml:
name = "solidity-lean"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["Solidity", "solkeycheck", "solidity-lean"]
# Build products go to Lake's cache, keyed by the hash of their inputs and
# shared by every checkout on this toolchain: a copy, a worktree or a branch
# switched back to reuses what any of them built (`AGENTS.md`, "Copies and
# branches").
enableArtifactCache = true

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Solidity"
weakLeanArgs = ["--tstack=131072", "-j1"]

# Taclet-text conformance against solkey's `solidityProgramRules.key`.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "solkeycheck"
root = "SolkeyCheck"
weakLeanArgs = ["-j1"]

[[lean_exe]]
name = "solidity-lean"
root = "SolidityLean"
weakLeanArgs = ["-j1"]

# The solkey example corpus, generated by `scripts/solkey-port.mjs`: one
# module per ported contract, checked by `scripts/check-corpus.sh`. Not a
# default target; `lake build SolidityCorpus` builds it and its imports only.
[[lean_lib]]
name = "SolidityCorpus"
weakLeanArgs = ["--tstack=131072", "-j1"]

# solkey's `TestSuite.sol`, imported from solc's AST at elaboration time
# (`solc_import`, `Solidity/Frontend/Import.lean`; the fixture is
# `tests/solc/TestSuite.ast.json`, `scripts/solc-ast.mjs` writes it). Not a
# default target; `lake build SolkeyTestSuite` builds it and its imports only.
[[lean_lib]]
name = "SolkeyTestSuite"
weakLeanArgs = ["--tstack=131072", "-j1"]

# LeanTeX text printer, vendored from fm-04; no ProofWidgets dependency.
[[lean_lib]]
name = "LeanTeX"
srcDir = "vendor/LeanTeX"
commands.executedContinuousMonitor:
import subprocess,time,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('.lake/source-units/docker-gate');low=10**20;start=time.monotonic();stop=False
while not (p/'exit-v2').exists():
 a=int(next(l.split()[1] for l in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith('MemAvailable:')));low=min(low,a)
 if a<12*1024**2:
  subprocess.run(['docker','--host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock','kill','source-units-combined-gate-v2']);stop=True;break
 (p/'headroom-continuous.json').write_text(json.dumps({'observedSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'minimumMemAvailableKiB':low,'reserveKiB':12*1024**2,'resourceStop':stop})+'\n');time.sleep(.2)
print('monitor finished; resourceStop=',stop)
